in_sanskrit.name: निरोग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: निर्जन (निर् = absence of) + ओग (गतिः = disease, ailment) = absence of disease

in_marathi.name: Nirogi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Free from disease
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirogi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nirogi is derived from Sanskrit, and it means 'free from disease'. This name is used to bless a child with good health and prosperity.
